_about: AdMob IDs for IDSnap (publisher pub-6432767564862835). ONE source of truth: Gradle reads android.appId for the manifest, the app reads the rest as a bundled asset. These are not secrets (they are visible in every APK). Release builds use them; debug and profile builds always use Google's sample IDs instead. Override with --dart-define=IDSNAP_ADMOB_* if needed. iOS is empty: ads stay off on iOS until its IDs are added here. See docs/adr/0013-free-with-ads.md.
